cases.case: a message to the whole room is posted under its submission id and routed to every member
/ask names its members in order, by name, and routes to them alone

sends.prompt: /ask Bench lead, GitHub 감시 check the build

cases.case: a message's files go up with its row: the log stores them and the row carries references

cases.case: a submission sent again, in the same process or after a restart of the room host, is acknowledged once and posted once
an addressee that is no member of the room is refused

threw.message: No member of this room has that name.

cases.case: a switched-off addressee is refused with its code and name
a message with nothing to send is refused
a room that no longer exists refuses the message
a file part with no bytes is dropped: the row goes up with its text
an attached file the log refuses refuses the message: no row, nothing routed, nothing stored
two sends with one submission id at once: the second arrives while the first is on its way
the room is stopped while a message is on its way: it is posted and routes nothing
a room keeps its newest 64 submission ids: an older one sent again is taken again (routed and kept; the log holds one row per id)
a send without a submission id, and one whose id is no row id, get a row id of the room; the second is still deduplicated
a pasted image naming a file the store does not hold, or no content address, reads no file
the text limit: 1,000,000 units are posted, one more is refused before anything happens
the attachment counts: 8 images and 8 files are posted, a ninth image or file is refused before anything happens
